question: Should OpenClaw add a configurable acknowledgement-reaction pool, and if so should selection be deterministic/random rather than model-driven before acknowledgement is sent?
rationale: The existing acknowledgement is intentionally sent before normal agent processing, so selection semantics determine latency, predictability, configuration shape, and channel fallback guarantees.

options.title: Keep one fixed reaction
options.body: Retain the current low-latency, predictable singular acknowledgement contract and close the feature request as not planned.

options.title: Add a deterministic reaction pool
options.body: Preserve `ackReaction` compatibility and add a bounded configured pool with documented selection and per-channel fallback rules.

options.title: Add model-driven selection
options.body: Let the agent choose an emoji per message, accepting added latency and a new pre-ack model-policy contract.

recommendation.title: Add a deterministic reaction pool
recommendation.body: Preserve `ackReaction` compatibility and add a bounded configured pool with documented selection and per-channel fallback rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Current feature-history evidence ties this person to the central acknowledgement configuration and runtime path.
